name: Nominal IrisValue decoding uses declared factories only

input.source_text: contract Serializable { fun serialize() -> Object } class Ghost { public class fun deserialize(representation) -> Object { :leaked } } module M { public fun run() -> Object { mut s = %{}; s["magic"] = "IRISVALUE"; s["format_version"] = 1; s["nominal"] = :Ghost; s["schema_version"] = 1; s["payload"] = 7;  IrisValue.decode(s) } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Supported. C020 calls only DECLARED standard deserialization factories and C004 forbids duck typing from implying eligibility, so a Class carrying a matching `deserialize` but no `for Serializable` conformance is refused WITHOUT being invoked: the probe answers SerializationError rather than the `:leaked` its factory would have returned.
